intro.zh: 今天这批项目透露出一个清晰信号：围绕 AI 编码代理的「外围工程」正在快速成形——有人做逆向分析、有人做语音输入输出、有人做多模型路由与移动端遥控，核心模型反而退居幕后。与此同时，Rust 重写的 Python 工具链持续占据榜单，说明开发者愿意为确定性的速度提升买单。
intro.en: Today's list points to a clear shift: the tooling around coding agents is maturing faster than the models themselves. Reverse engineering, voice I/O, multi-model routing, and mobile control are all being built as separate products.

zh.summary: 一个基于 MCP 的逆向工程代理，能从应用行为一路分析到原生二进制。它解决的是「看到别人产品的好功能却不知道怎么做」的问题，把原本需要资深逆向工程师的活交给代理执行。
zh.insight: 适合做竞品技术拆解服务：面向出海团队或安全审计方，切入点是「功能级对标报告」，而不是通用逆向工具。差异在于把二进制分析包装成可读的产品决策文档。

en.summary: An MCP-based reverse engineering agent that works from app behavior down to native binaries. It targets teams that see a feature they like but cannot tell how it was built,
en.insight: A competitive teardown service is the obvious wedge: sell feature-level reports to teams shipping abroad or to security auditors,

items.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.

zh.summary: DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端，内置免 Root 的 Linux 环境，既能手机本机跑代理，也能远程接管电脑上的会话。它解决的是编码代理被绑在桌面端、离开工位就断线的问题。
zh.insight: 机会在「移动端代理控制台」：面向需要随时查看长任务进度的开发者，做通知、插话、审批这类轻交互。和官方网页版的差别是把等待变成可随时介入。

en.summary: An Android client for DeepSeek Harness with a built-in root-free Linux environment, running agents on the phone or taking over a session on your desktop.
en.insight: The opening is a mobile control plane for agents: notifications, mid-run interjections, and approvals for developers watching long jobs.

items.description: dsh-go — DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：手机本机运行，也能遥控你的电脑。

zh.summary: 一个多模型代理编排层，用关键词触发图工程式的任务分解，附带记忆系统和跨 IDE 支持。它解决的是单模型代理在复杂任务上容易跑偏、且缺乏长期记忆的问题。
zh.insight: 可借的角度是把编排能力做成垂直工作流：面向数据工程或运维场景，预置任务图模板。和通用代理框架的差别在于不追求通用，而是把某类任务的图固化下来。

en.summary: A multi-model agent orchestration layer that triggers graph-style task decomposition from a keyword, with a memory system and cross-IDE support.
en.insight: Take the orchestration and make it vertical: ship preset task graphs for data engineering or ops. The difference from general agent frameworks is refusing…

items.description: OmO: Just type "mass ulw" keyword with your prompt. Now you are the master of graph engineering.

zh.summary: 开源的本地语音工作室，集声音克隆、语音生成和全局听写于一体，整套语音 I/O 跑在本机。它解决的是隐私敏感用户不想把声音数据交给云服务的问题，也适合给代理配上自有音色。
zh.insight: 可以切「本地语音输入法」这个细分场景：面向律师、医生等不能上云的职业，卖的是合规而不是音质。和云端 TTS 的差别在于数据不出设备。

en.summary: An open-source local voice studio bundling cloning, speech generation, and system-wide dictation, with the whole voice I/O stack running on-device.
en.insight: Target local dictation for regulated professions like lawyers and clinicians, selling compliance rather than audio quality.

items.description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 一个菜单栏应用加本地网关，让 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等代理自由切换模型和账号，配额耗尽时自动换下一个。它解决的是各家代理配置格式互不相通、订阅被锁死在单一工具里的问题。
zh.insight: 适合做团队级的模型配额调度层：面向同时订阅多家模型的小团队，按成本自动路由请求。和单机工具的区别在于把「个人省钱」升级成「团队可审计」。

en.summary: A menu bar app plus local gateway that lets Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI swap models and accounts freely, falling back when a quota runs dry.
en.insight: Build a team-level quota router on top: route requests by cost across several model subscriptions.

items.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: Meta 的分割一切模型第二代，把图像分割扩展到视频，支持可提示的视觉分割，附推理代码和示例。它解决的是视频中逐帧抠像和跟踪成本极高的问题，是视觉管线里的基础能力。
zh.insight: 适合作为基础设施被封装：面向短视频或电商内容团队，做「一键换背景/商品抠图」的批处理服务。价值不在模型本身，而在把视频分割接进现有剪辑流程。

en.summary: Meta's second Segment Anything model extends promptable segmentation from images to video, with inference code and notebooks.
en.insight: Wrap it as infrastructure: batch background removal or product cutouts for short-video and e-commerce teams.

items.description: The repository provides code for running inference with the Meta Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2), links for downloading the trained model checkpoints, and example notebooks that show how to use the model.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 用 Rust 写的 Python 包与项目管理器，一个工具替代 pip、poetry、pyenv 等多个组件，带通用锁文件。它解决的是 Python 依赖管理碎片化、CI 里装包慢的问题，现在已是很多团队默认选择。
zh.insight: 更适合作为基础设施而非创业方向。若要借力，可做围绕锁文件的供应链审计或 CI 缓存服务，切入点是「依赖变更的可解释性」。

en.summary: A Rust-written Python package and project manager replacing pip, poetry, pyenv, and more with one tool and a universal lockfile.
en.insight: Treat this as infrastructure, not a startup. If you build nearby, target supply-chain auditing or CI caching around the lockfile,

items.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.

zh.summary: Rust 实现的 Python linter 与格式化工具，速度比 Flake8、Black 快一到两个数量级，内置九百多条规则并兼容主流插件。它解决的是大型仓库里静态检查拖慢开发循环的问题。
zh.insight: 同样偏基础设施。可借的点是规则生态：为特定团队（如金融、嵌入式）编写自定义规则集并做持续合规检查，卖的是行业规范而非工具本身。

en.summary: A Rust-based Python linter and formatter running one to two orders of magnitude faster than Flake8 and Black, with 900+ built-in rules and plugin parity.
en.insight: Also infrastructure. The exploitable surface is the rule ecosystem: author custom rule packs for regulated teams and run continuous compliance checks,

items.description: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust.

zh.summary: 高度可定制的 changelog 生成器，基于 conventional commits 和正则解析从 Git 历史生成发布说明，支持 monorepo。它解决的是发布流程中人工整理变更记录既慢又容易漏的问题。
zh.insight: 可以往「发布合规」方向做：面向需要向客户交付变更说明的 B2B 软件团队，把 changelog 和工单、审计记录关联起来。和原工具的差别是从开发者自用走向对外交付。

en.summary: A highly customizable changelog generator that builds release notes from Git history using conventional commits and regex parsers, with monorepo support.
en.insight: Push toward release compliance: link changelogs to tickets and audit trails for B2B teams that owe customers change notes.

items.description: A highly customizable Changelog Generator that follows Conventional Commit specifications ⛰️

zh.summary: 命令行工具，从 Spotify 播放列表匹配 YouTube 音源并下载歌曲，附带封面、歌词和元数据。它满足的是离线收听和本地曲库整理的需求，长期保持活跃说明这类需求稳定存在。
zh.insight: 直接做商业化风险高，版权是硬约束。可借的角度是本地音乐库的整理与迁移工具：面向换平台或自建 NAS 曲库的用户，做元数据修复而非下载。

en.summary: A CLI that matches Spotify playlists to YouTube sources and downloads tracks with cover art, lyrics, and metadata.
en.insight: Commercializing it directly is risky given copyright. A safer angle is library migration and repair for people moving platforms or running a NAS,

items.description: Download your Spotify playlists and songs along with album art and metadata (from YouTube if a match is found).
